mutations.name: a parked card is excused by any later sample of its beat
kills: a card that never enters the frame is still off-frame

mutations.name: a parked card is never excused by its entrance
kills: a card parked off frame until its cue is not off-frame once it enters
a card that enters and is cut by the frame edge mid-slide is judged on that sample

mutations.name: the entrance is looked for in every beat, not the card's own
kills: a card parked in one beat is not excused by another beat where it is on frame
